title: Associate in Business, AB-DTA/MRP
sourceText:

Degrees and Certificates

Associate in Business, AB-DTA/MRP

Associate in Business, AB-DTA/MRP

Join the largest business transfer program in Washington State. This degree prepares you to transfer to a four-year college where you’ll be ready to major in business or related areas such as finance, marketing, or accounting. This program meets the high standards of business schools accredited by the Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business.

Visit Program Website

Program Information

                Degree
                Associate in Business - Direct Transfer Agreement

                                  Duration
                  90 credits

                                  Program Prerequisite

None

                Pathway

Business

                                  Focus Areas

Business Administration – Transfer

Course Maps

A course map is a quick guide to help students figure out which courses to take each quarter. Course maps were written by BC faculty, who have used their expertise to recommend specific courses students can take to achieve their academic or career goals. Students should meet with an advisor to learn more.
